svg.title: §2 Manuscripts: seven papers on privacy accounting, training integrity, LLM-judge bias and interpretability.
svg.text: Manuscripts
Every one of them also reports where its own method breaks.
The Real Cost of Anytime-Validity: An E-Process Retrofit for Training-Integrity
Monitoring, and Where It Breaks
NeurIPS 2026 workshop
Adds a formal anytime-valid false-alarm guarantee, fixes a composite-null validity bug, and
derives a reweighted betting mixture that Pareto-dominates every other fix tried.
Do LLM-Judge Biases Compose? A Label-Free Test for the Position × Verbosity
Interaction
NeurIPS 2026 workshop
Sequential debiasing leaves a residual when the two biases interact. SSIT detects it with no
gold labels; six of seven open judges show a positive interaction.
Manifold Alignment, Not Norm, Determines Sparse Autoencoder Fidelity
Under Steering
NeurIPS 2026 workshop
On a GPT-2 SAE, Certified Delta Attribution keeps 100% of the steering effect, against about
30% for projection-based corrections.
An Accounting Trap in Prototype-Based Federated Learning: Why the
Continual-Observation Fix Doesn’t Transfer
In preparation
A curious server can average per-round releases to recover a client’s prototype.
CN-FedProto fixes the accounting, and the paper reports a calibration error caught in its
own first analysis.
Diagnosing the CIFAR-10 Gap in Byzantine-Robust, Differentially Private
Federated Learning: Evaluation Artifacts and Remaining Limits
To be submitted
An eight-mechanism, Bonferroni-corrected audit. The fix works without DP on IID data,
and the paper says plainly that it collapses under real DP noise.
Mass-Calibrated Repulsive Reverse-KL: A Unified Algorithm for
Diversity-Preserving Mode Selection
To be submitted
Four corrective mechanisms in one optimization loop against five failure modes of
reverse-KL variational inference, with an ablation for each gain.
Can You Trust a Benchmark Score if You Can’t Trust the Training Run?
Black-Box Auditing of Optimization Trajectories for Evaluation Validity
To be submitted
Optimizer-trajectory curvature as a black-box audit signal; catches a baseline whose perfect
AUROC never crossed its own alert threshold.
